title: Communal street soft landscaping minimum 2.5 m wide (20 or more potential lots)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to the grouped package (no Chapter 2 twin). Applies where the communal street serves 20 or more potential strata or survey-strata lots (site.communal_street_serves_lots, read as potential lots or dwellings each taking driveway access from the communal street). Greenfield in practice. Uses the proposed fact site.communal_street_soft_landscape_width_m.
text: Notwithstanding C3.7.13, where a proposed development has the potential to be subdivided to create 20 or more strata lots or survey-strata lots, with each lot obtaining driveway access from a communal street, the communal street shall be a minimum 12m wide, which shall include: iii. soft landscaping of a minimum width 2.5m; and
